recipe.visualDefinition: A full-length outdoor portrait of two men standing on stepping stones in a pond, framed by weeping willow trees. The aesthetic is defined by 1970s fashion, soft natural lighting, and a mirrored water reflection that occupies the lower half of the composition.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical symmetry between the two subjects standing side-by-side
Horizontal division between the upper foliage and the lower water reflection
Textural contrast between the plaid patterns and the soft, organic willow leaves
Color harmony between the green foliage and the dark, flared trousers
coreInvariants: Bell-bottom trousers creating a wide base for the figures
Stepping stones as the physical anchor
Natural, slightly desaturated 70s film color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two full-length figures centered horizontally, occupying the middle vertical third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, heavy mass of the bell-bottom trousers and the stepping stones at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the faces, move down the long lines of the legs to the water, then follow the vertical willow branches back up.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense organic texture fills the negative space, primarily through the weeping willow leaves.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted sage and olive greens from the foliage and water.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal or black from the trousers.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm reds and browns in the typography and plaid shirts.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low to medium saturation with a compressed dynamic range typical of vintage film stock.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or high-chroma digital colors

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses a heavy, high-contrast serif with sharp terminals
Secondary text uses a fluid, formal cursive script
Tight letter spacing for the display face
characterSpecificRedesigns: Curved descenders on the script to mimic handwriting
Heavy bracketed serifs on the display face
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for impact paired with a delicate script for elegance.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rule separating text from the top edge

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s folk-rock aesthetic and heavy serif weight.
Provides the necessary delicate contrast for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A full-shot photograph of two men in 1970s attire (plaid shirts, bell-bottom jeans) standing on rocks in a pond. Behind them are dense weeping willow trees. The water reflects the trees and the men. Use a vintage 35mm film look with soft lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large bold serif title in red with a thin white outline in the top right corner. Below it, add a smaller white script subtitle. Include a thin horizontal line above the title.

verificationChecks: Are the trousers flared at the bottom?
Is the background composed of weeping willow leaves?
Is the text right-aligned in the upper quadrant?
Is the color palette muted and earthy?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of red for the title

mustAchieve: Clear vertical reflection in the water

postGenerationChecks: Check for the presence of stepping stones
Ensure the plaid patterns look period-accurate
Verify the high-contrast serif font has a vintage feel
Confirm the reflection matches the subjects above
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Folk-Rock Aesthetic = (70s Fashion + Weeping Willows + Water Reflection) * (High-Contrast Serif + Script Pairing)
